description: Buys a trial, a single class or a class pack at a Gymmy gym and books the class in one go, for the signed-in person (any Gymmy account, no membership needed). First call without confirm: returns the summary (price, class) to confirm with the person. Then call with confirm: true, first_name and last_name: returns a Stripe Checkout link on the gym's own account (the spot is held 30 min), or books right away when free. Follow up with checkout_status. Nothing is charged by this tool.

class_id.description: Class id (from search_classes). Optional with a class pack.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes to the summary returned by the first call.

first_name.description: The person's first name (asked once, needed with confirm).

last_name.description: The person's last name (needed with confirm).

offer_id.description: Offer id (from search_classes offers). Default: the cheapest single entry.

site_id.description: Site id when the gym has several.

name: book_dropin
title: Buy and book a class
